children: A friendly neighborhood clinic for dogs and cats — wellness, vaccines, sick visits, dental and senior care, all under one warm roof.

children: Gentle hands, calm rooms and all the time your pet needs. We treat every animal like our own — because to us, they are.
When something’s off, you shouldn’t have to wait days. We hold room every morning for pets who need to be seen now.
From a wiggly new puppy to a wise old cat, we care for the whole family — and keep the visit as low-stress as we can.
You’ll always know the cost before we begin. No surprises, no upsells — just straight answers and fair prices.

children: Cedar Paws is a neighborhood clinic, not a rush-you-through hospital. We keep the day unhurried so every visit gets a real conversation — about your pet, your worries, and what will actually help.

You’ll see doctors and techs who remember your pet’s name, know their history, and explain everything in plain language. That’s the whole idea: fewer surprises, more trust, and a team that’s genuinely on your side.

children: The doctors and techs who’ll get to know your pet by name.
Surgery, dentistry and everyday wellness. Maya founded Cedar Paws to do medicine slowly and kindly.
A soft spot for senior pets and the anxious ones — the cats who hide and the dogs who shake.
Vaccines, nail trims and treat-forward visits. Jordan makes the hard days a little easier.

pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Cedar Paws Veterinary is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A happy dog resting a paw on a caring veterinarian during a check-up

children: We opened Cedar Paws to be the kind of clinic we’d want for our own pets — warm, unhurried, and honest. A place where you’re greeted by name, where the exam room feels calm, and where nobody makes you feel rushed or talked-down-to.

We’re a full-service neighborhood practice for dogs and cats: wellness and vaccines, sick and same-day visits, dentistry, surgery and gentle senior care. Whatever your pet needs, we’ll walk through it together.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Quiet rooms, gentle handling and treats on hand — we work at your pet’s pace to make the visit easier on everyone.
We explain what we see, what it means and what your options are — no jargon, no pressure, just clear guidance you can trust.
From first puppy shots to the tender senior years, we’re the steady team that knows your pet through every stage of life.
